definitions.explanation: the aesthetic quality of blur in out-of-focus areas of a photograph, now used internationally as a photography term
in Japanese comedy (especially manzai), the person who makes absurd statements or acts silly, contrasted with the tsukkomi

examples.english: I took a photo with beautiful bokeh.

notes:
PHOTOGRAPHY (SENSE 1):
'Bokeh' has been adopted into English as a photography term. It refers to the quality of the out-of-focus areas in an image.
- ⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧ボケ - background blur
- ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ボケ - circular bokeh balls (from point light sources)
- ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ボケ - foreground blur

COMEDY (SENSE 2):
In manzai comedy, the ボケ makes absurd statements or acts foolish, while the ⟦ツッコミ→ツッコミ：09412_tsukkomi⟧ (straight man) corrects or retorts.
- ボケ⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧ - the funny man role
- ボケ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ - to insert a joke

AGING (SENSE 3):
Used to describe age-related cognitive decline. Can be considered somewhat casual or even insensitive depending on context.
- ボケ⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ - prevention of senility
- ⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧ - dementia (medical term)
